description: This file defines the static class SugarHtml, which provides helper methods for creating, parsing, and rendering HTML elements and templates, including support for Smarty template syntax. It contains constants, methods for HTML element creation, parsing HTML and Smarty strings into array representations, and rendering them back into strings.

classes.name: SugarHtml
classes.description: A static class offering methods for programmatic creation, parsing, and rendering of HTML and Smarty templates within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: createOpenTag
methods.description: Creates an opening HTML tag string with specified attributes and self-closing option.

methods.name: createCloseTag
methods.description: Creates a closing HTML tag string.

methods.name: createHtml
methods.description: Recursively generates HTML code from a cascade array structure representing HTML elements, including support for Smarty templates.

methods.name: parseSugarHtml
methods.description: Converts a SugarHtml array structure into an array suitable for HTML rendering, specifically for input elements.

methods.name: parseHtmlTag
methods.description: Disassembles an HTML string, including Smarty blocks, into a cascade array structure.

methods.name: parseSmartyTag
methods.description: Disassembles a Smarty template string into a cascade array, handling nested Smarty and HTML segments.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Parses HTML attribute string into a key-value array, handling quotes and Smarty syntax.

methods.name: createAttributes
methods.description: Creates HTML attribute string from a key-value array.
